title: Shared Mobility - Worldwide
highlights: The Shared Mobility market is expected to generate a revenue of US$1.68tn worldwide by 2026.
The market is anticipated to experience an annual growth rate of 4.96% (CAGR 2026-2030), resulting in a projected market volume of US$2.04tn by 2030.
Flights is the largest market, expected to reach a market volume of US$743.26bn in 2026.
By 2030, the number of users in Public Transportation is expected to increase to 4.99bn users.
In the Shared Mobility market, the user penetration rate is projected to grow from 69.2% in 2026 to 75.7% by 2030.
The average revenue per user (ARPU) is projected to be US$306.60.
Online sales are expected to generate 72% of the total revenue in the Shared Mobility market by 2030.
In comparison to other countries, China is expected to generate the most revenue, reaching US$402bn in 2026.
Despite the COVID-19 pandemic, shared mobility services continue to thrive in countries such as Germany, France, and the United States.
